data.name: MixCD
data.detailed_description:
This is a Totally Automated and A.I. Generated Driving Simulation Game.

While on a break from her A.I. Generated World Music Tour, Zora Romani and her friends Ben Raider, and Sandy Niro drive to their hometown.

They embark on an adventure together, around town and in the bedroom.

Most of the Townsfolk are on a trip to the mainland for a Steam Convention.

She makes them an A.I. Generated Music "MIX" CD from her Brony "MixMAN" Portable Music Device.

They Play through memories, set to the A.I. Generated soundtrack of their generation.

While they travel to a V.R. LAN party together, They play the perfect playlist of Hits from the Twisted Mind of ARCHOR MUSIC.

This takes the 3 Friends in directions they never thought they would go together.

Experience a variety of areas exploring their A.I. Generated Storyline together.

Players will be immersed in the Autonomous Gameplay, from NOT Driving Cars, to NOT Walking in a Simulator, NOT taking photos, NOT hitting golf balls, and NOT putting on a night time DRONE Light Show, while NOT making out in the backseat of their car, OK, maybe that last one did happen.

It's the greatest A.I. Generated hits of the 80s experience, from their kisses to their passion for each other.

From ARCHOR GAMES, The A.I. Generated Award Winning game developers of MANY Global Hits.

In this A.I. Generated Artful Escape, MixCD draws inspiration from classic A.I. Generated coming-of-age 80s movies, bringing together nostalgic music and ideas, the highs and lows of being in a love triangle, and the bittersweet feelings brought about by A.I. Prompting, Copy/Pasting, and groovin' in the sheets.

Featuring A.I. Generated music from the Steam MEME Game King Archor Wright.

Don't Skate, Don't Party and Don't run from the law.

Don't Hang out, Don't Sneak out, and ... Well ... DO Make out!

Because this A.I. Powered Game is So Amazing, it plays itself!

So, Set the Number of Players to Zero.

The Only Way to Win is NOT to Play and just sit back, Relax and Listen to The A.I. Generated Soundtrack of the Ages!

Wait ... What???

OH, OK, so YOU Actually want to "PLAY" this A.I. Generated Monster hit???

Well, Alright, I guess...

Sooooo... go get Your Keyboard, Mouse and/or Gamepad out of the landfill and "Plug in the Donkey"!

Using Your Crypto Bro Skillz, Can You Mine bitco... errr . . . I mean can You "collect" ALL of the CDs to get ARCH COINS to 'WIN' the day and Save the World from the evil A.I. generated studio ARCHOR GAMES?

Each CD is worth 69 ARCH COINS.

Good Luck! . . . We are ALL counting on You! . . . No Pressure!

**********

List of A.I. Generated AWARDS from Industry Reviewers, Who totally were not PAID OFF in any way . . .

**********

( 10/10 - Leon Skum )

( 11/10 - GROK )

( 10/10 - Bird Cage Liner Weekly )

( 12/10 - Don't Sue Me, Suno )

( 10/10 - /. )

( 15/10 - AYBABTU )

( 10/10 - Jeff Bedsoaks )

( 101/10 - Sticky Pages Magazine )

( 1/10 - Caleb Handle ) {Oops, Nevermind, the A.I. bots got to him, it's 10/10 now}

*********

Challenges:

"Steamy Streamer" Challenge - Get ALL of the Archor Games products available on Steam and Stream ALL of them.

"IRL ARG" Challenge - This game and some other ARCHOR GAMES are part of an "Alternate Reality Game" "In Real Life" Challenge, be sure to check out ALL of our games for Clues to the ongoing Mystery.

How many Total Music Tracks are on the CD?

How Many "ARCH Coins" are there in Total?

Did You spot ALL of the Easter Eggs?

*********

The Story, Music, Concept, Graphics, Video, Noodles, Kitchen Sink as well as the Player have been A.I. Generated * *
